plan.notes: Official RN to BSN Plan of Study, St. John's College Undergraduate Catalog 2025-2026 (p. 24). Ten-month fully online program for working associate-degree RNs; fall start only. Professional-phase plan: this seed models the 25-credit upper-division sequence only; the BSN award is 120 credits and the RN to BSN program accepts transfer credits from the associate-degree nursing program plus general-education credits (successful completion of at least 80 transfer credits is expected). Requirements: current licensed RN and full-time RN work experience (0.9 FTE or higher) of at least one continuous year in the past two years. Course titles per the catalog's BSN Nursing Courses section.
